from PIL import Image

# Load the image and apply object detection
image_path = '/home/stud/wxie/BLINK_Dataset/Counting/val/images/val_Counting_106_image_1.jpg'
execution = tool.execute(image=image_path, labels=["tennis court"], threshold=0.2)

predicted_labels = np.array(execution)

predictions = {
    'labeled_image': image_path,
    'predictions': predictions
}

# Find the positions of white vertical lines on the ground
grounded_objects = predicted_labels['predictions'][predictions['predictions'] <= 0.35][['label', 'bbox']]

# For each object, find the x and y center coordinates
object_centers = grounded_objects[['bbox']]
object_centers['bbox'] = [object_centers['bbox'][0]-20, object_centers['bbox'][1]-20, object_centers['bbox'][2]+20, object_centers['bbox'][3]+20]

# Draw a red line every 100 pixels from the bottom of the ground
color_line = (128, 0, 0)
size_line = 4

for i in range(0, len(object_centers), 10):
    top_x, top_y = map(int, object_centers[['bbox']][i]['bbox'][0]+i*20, object_centers[['bbox']][i]['bbox'][1])
    bottom_x, bottom_y = map(int, object_centers[['bbox']][i+1]['bbox'][0]+i+100, object_centers[['bbox']][i+1]['bbox'][1])
